summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share buy-back transactions under the second tranche of its 2026 programme. From 6-10 July 2026, Equinor purchased 507,713 own shares at an average price of NOK 327.34 per share. The buy-back was announced 6 May 2026 and runs 19 May–20 July 2026. Following these purchases, Equinor holds 13,767,701 own shares (0.58% of share capital). This is an ordinary share repurchase under EU Market Abuse Regulation disclosure rules, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
